From cad237b6c875fbee5d353a2b289e98d240d17ec8 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: Abdun Nihaal <nihaal@cse.iitm.ac.in>
Date: Tue, 23 Dec 2025 11:19:01 +0530
Subject: [PATCH] media: i2c/tw9906: Fix potential memory leak in
 tw9906_probe()

In one of the error paths in tw9906_probe(), the memory allocated in
v4l2_ctrl_handler_init() and v4l2_ctrl_new_std() is not freed. Fix that
by calling v4l2_ctrl_handler_free() on the handler in that error path.

Cc: stable@vger.kernel.org
Fixes: a000e9a02b58 ("[media] tw9906: add Techwell tw9906 video decoder")
Signed-off-by: Abdun Nihaal <nihaal@cse.iitm.ac.in>
Signed-off-by: Hans Verkuil <hverkuil+cisco@kernel.org>

diff --git a/drivers/media/i2c/tw9906.c b/drivers/media/i2c/tw9906.c
index 6220f4fddbab..0ab43fe42d7f 100644
--- a/drivers/media/i2c/tw9906.c
+++ b/drivers/media/i2c/tw9906.c
@@ -196,6 +196,7 @@ static int tw9906_probe(struct i2c_client *client)
 
 	if (write_regs(sd, initial_registers) < 0) {
 		v4l2_err(client, "error initializing TW9906\n");
+		v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(hdl);
 		return -EINVAL;
 	}
 
-- 
2.34.1

The patch fixes a potential memory leak in the `tw9906_probe()` function by adding a call to `v4l2_ctrl_handler_free()` in an error path that previously returned without releasing the control handler.

### Modifications in each file

- **`drivers/media/i2c/tw9906.c`**:  
  Added `v4l2_ctrl_handler_free(hdl);` before `return -EINVAL;` in the error path where `write_regs(sd, initial_registers)` fails.

### Relationships between file modifications

This change is isolated to a single file. The relationship is internal to the function: the newly added line ensures that memory allocated for the control handler by `v4l2_ctrl_handler_init()` and `v4l2_ctrl_new_std()` is freed when the device initialization fails, preventing a memory leak. The error path is now properly cleaned up, consistent with other error paths in the same function (e.g., the one after `v4l2_ctrl_new_std()` fails).
